title: Horned Muse by the Pond
description: A blue-skinned horned female figure with a long tail stands in a surreal pond, holding a sheet of dripping musical notation. She reaches toward a white butterfly as black birds perch on a gnarled tree filled with glowing orbs and a large sphere showing two silhouetted lovers.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a blue-skinned female figure with large curved horns, long flowing black hair, and a tail, standing in a reflective pond. She holds a large dripping musical score with notation and reaches toward a white butterfly. A gnarled tree with yellow cherry blossoms grows from the water, covered in glowing blue orbs and spheres, one showing two silhouetted lovers under a pink tree. Black birds perch on the tree and fly above. Swirling green and pink sky with floating eyes and petals, in a vibrant mystical digital painting style.
